fieldValues.title: Keep the queue fed
fieldValues.description: Find ruling-backed work in conformance gaps and in rulings not yet implemented, and file it as ready wg:third-party-ready issues, without needing a new ruling.
fieldValues.done_when: The ready group queue holds at least one to two cycles of ruling-backed work, or the sources are exhausted and that is reported
fieldValues.trigger: Daily 12:00 UTC check; acts only when the latest cycle report forecasts 'Queue running dry'
fieldValues.size: At most 12 new issues per run
